title: Termination Security on Noticed C&I Terminations
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - termination security.**

Termination security protects Beacon Ridge while a business that gave written notice to end a contract early still owes the damages billed on it and the supply it takes until the termination effective date.

Termination security is recorded on a contract in termination pending status whose termination came from written notice during the term, and the business's authorized signatory remits it from the business's own account.

## When the amount is settled

The termination security is fixed only after the bill of the terminating contract carries its early termination fee line.

The termination security is not worked out until every contract of the same business that closed before its supply began carries its early termination fee line.

## Remittance: `post_termination_security_b7051944`

The remittance is the customer's own action. The agent unlocks `post_termination_security_b7051944` and hands it over, and the customer themselves, through the business's authorized signatory, runs it.

**Capability.** One run records one security deposit receipt of the stated dollar amount against one commercial and industrial electricity contract, remitted from the business's own bank account and dated today. The security Beacon Ridge holds on the contract rises by exactly that amount, and the receipt then appears among the contract's security deposits. The receipt records no months of supply cost, because this security is not sized in months. Nothing else on the contract changes.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cni_contract_id` | the commercial and industrial contract number of the contract the security is posted on, as shown on the contract record returned by the contract lookup | contract number |
| `amount_usd` | the dollar amount remitted | US dollars, a positive number rounded half up to 2 decimal places; stored exactly as passed |
| `credit_grade_basis` | the commercial credit grade written on the receipt, copied from the grade recorded on the contract's existing security deposit receipt | one of the values below |

Values of `credit_grade_basis`: `A` when the existing receipt records grade A; `B` when it records grade B; `C` when it records grade C; `not_rated` when it records not rated; `""` (empty) only when the contract has no existing receipt to copy a grade from.

**Return.** A confirmation carrying `cni_deposit_id` (the reference number of the new security deposit receipt), `cni_contract_id` (the contract secured), `amount_usd` (the amount recorded, 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and a status that is always "recorded", meaning the security now counts toward what Beacon Ridge holds on the contract.

## Illustration of the grade value (hypothetical)

A contract whose existing security deposit receipt records grade B takes `credit_grade_basis` `B` on the new receipt; a contract with no receipt at all takes `""`.
